FINDINGS TO FIX:
1. HIGH bridge ~:1006 (stale QA endorsement) — when the post-rewrite Gmail refresh fails, the card correctly loses the autosend marker BUT still carries 'voice_qa: pass' in its gate packet and stale review content, so a human can APPROVE a draft whose final body was never QA'd (the executor refuses any packet whose voice_qa is not exactly 'pass'). Fix: on refresh failure, the emitted packet's voice_qa value must become 'stale-refresh-failed' (never 'pass'), and the card body/review comment must state that QA did not run on the final body and approval requires re-running the bridge. Test: refresh-failure card's packet parses with voice_qa != 'pass'.
2. HIGH bridge ~:275 (entity-encoded URL bypass) — HTML-entity-encoded targets like https://evil.com are discarded by normalization instead of being decoded, so they pass link_integrity yet render as clickable links in Gmail. Fix: html.unescape() (repeatedly until stable, max 3 rounds, to catch double-encoding) the draft body BEFORE link extraction; additionally, if the ORIGINAL body still contains entity sequences that decode into scheme-like or domain-like tokens ('//', '.' between alphanumerics, '://'), treat that as an obfuscation attempt = link_integrity FAIL regardless of allowlist. Tests: entity-encoded off-allowlist URL fails; entity-encoded ALLOWLISTED URL also fails (obfuscation itself is disqualifying); clean allowlisted URL still passes.
3. MED server/pipeline/outreach.py ~:187 (referrer name-token binding) — validate_referrer_episode_url accepts a URL if ANY single name token matches, so a 'Bethany Fishbein' referral accepts an unrelated 'bethany-smith' episode URL. Fix: require ALL alphabetic tokens of the referrer's full name (len>=2, casefolded) to appear in the URL slug, OR an exact known-slug match when the caller provides one; single-token match is never sufficient. This function is used by live outreach paths — keep the signature backward compatible and change the minimum necessary. Tests (new file tests/test_referrer_link_binding.py): bethany-smith URL rejected for Bethany Fishbein; bethany-fishbein URL accepted; hyphen/case variants accepted; single-name referrers (only one token) require that token plus rejection when the slug contains a DIFFERENT second name token.
4. MED scripts/ensure_referral_touch_tracker.py ~:71 (partial-write window) — the O_EXCL creation publishes the target path before content is written and fsynced, so a concurrent reader can see partial JSON. Fix: write the full content to a uniquely-named temp file in the same directory (fsync it), then os.link(tmp, target) to claim exclusively (EEXIST = concurrent writer won, keep theirs), then unlink the temp; the target must never be observable in a partial state. Update the existing race test to assert the target is either absent or complete valid JSON at every observable point (poll from a reader thread during creation).
